title: Exploring the therapeutic mechanism of Banxia Xiexin Decoction in mild cognitive impairment and diabetes mellitus: a network pharmacology approach.
authors: Li, Cong; Yang, Wei; Meng, Yubo; Feng, Lina; Sun, Linlin; Li, Zhenghong; Liu, Xingfang; Li, Mingquan
one_liner_zh: 网络药理学研究半夏泻心汤治疗轻度认知障碍和糖尿病的共同机制，仅涉及分子对接验证，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The incidence of mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and diabetes mellitus (DM) is increasing year by year. Clinical findings show that Banxia Xiexin Decoction (BXD) can be combined to treat MCI and DM. However, the principle and mechanism of BXD in treating MCI and DM remain unclear. In this study, to explore the common mechanism of BXD in treating MCI and DM by using the method of network pharmacology. Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology Database (TCMSP) was used to screen the main active components of BXD, as well as to predict and screen its potential targets. Using Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man (OMIM), Therapeutic Target Database (TTD), DisGeNET, GeneCards to select the target proteins of two diseases, and intersecting the drug target and the disease target to obtain the common target of drug diseases, which is imported into cytoscape software to draw the network diagram of "drug components-target diseases" and the interaction network diagram between the common target proteins. According to the Database for Annotation, Visualization and Integrated Discovery (DAVID) database, we analyzed the common targets using two methods, gene ontology Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) biological pathway enrichment analysis and Gene Ontology (GO) function enrichment analysis, as well as studied the interaction mechanism of the two diseases, with the results validated using molecular docking. A total of 267 main active components of BXD were screened, together with the two diseases shared 233 common targets. The top five key targets identified by the topological analysis were TP53, AKT1, STAT3, TNF, and MAPK3. Go enrichment results indicated that it was primarily related to response to drug, extracellular space, enzyme binding, RNA polymerase II transcription factor activity, ligand-activated sequence-specific DNA binding. t KEGG enrichment pathway analysis identified 20 significant pathways, the majority of which are AGE-RAGE signaling pathways in diabetic complications, lipid and atherosclerosis, fluid shear stress and atherosclerosis, IL-17 signaling pathway, TNF signaling pathway, and so on. The results of molecular docking revealed that the key components of BXD, baicalein, licochalcone a, quercetin, and naringenin, had strong binding ability with core targets TP53, AKT1, STAT3, TNF, MAPK3. BXD can treat MCI and DM by multi-targets and multi-channels,and plays a role of "homotherapy for heteropathy" mainly through response to drug, positive regulation of gene expression, extracellular space and enzyme binding and other ways.
abstract_zh: 轻度认知障碍（mild cognitive impairment, MCI）和糖尿病（diabetes mellitus, DM）的发病率逐年上升。临床研究发现，半夏泻心汤（Banxia Xiexin Decoction, BXD）可联合治疗MCI和DM。然而，BXD治疗MCI和DM的原理及机制尚不清楚。本研究采用网络药理学方法探讨BXD治疗MCI和DM的共同机制。利用中药系统药理学数据库（TCMSP）筛选BXD的主要活性成分，并预测和筛选其潜在靶点。通过在线人类孟德尔遗传数据库（OMIM）、治疗靶点数据库（TTD）、DisGeNET、GeneCards筛选两种疾病的靶蛋白，并将药物靶点与疾病靶点取交集，获得药物-疾病共同靶点，导入cytoscape软件绘制“药物成分-靶点-疾病”网络图和共同靶蛋白间的相互作用网络图。根据注释、可视化和综合发现数据库（DAVID）数据库，采用基因本体论京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）生物通路富集分析和基因本体论（GO）功能富集分析两种方法对共同靶点进行分析，并研究两种疾病的交互作用机制，结果采用分子对接验证。共筛选出BXD的267个主要活性成分，与两种疾病共享233个共同靶点。拓扑分析确定的前五个关键靶点为TP53、AKT1、STAT3、TNF和MAPK3。GO富集结果表明，其主要涉及药物反应、细胞外空间、酶结合、RNA聚合酶II转录因子活性、配体激活的序列特异性DNA结合。KEGG富集通路分析确定了20条显著通路，其中大部分为糖尿病并发症中的AGE-RAGE信号通路、脂质与动脉粥样硬化、流体剪切应力与动脉粥样硬化、IL-17信号通路、TNF信号通路等。分子对接结果显示，BXD的关键成分黄芩素、甘草查尔酮a、槲皮素和柚皮素与核心靶点TP53、AKT1、STAT3、TNF、MAPK3具有较强结合能力。BXD可通过多靶点、多通路治疗MCI和DM，主要通过药物反应、基因表达正调控、细胞外空间和酶结合等途径发挥“异病同治”作用。
